notes: The lengthened-imperative he of מַהֲרָה (s009, tagged Sd) was given 'thee' while the identical ending on לֵכָה (s012) in the same verse and the paragogic he of 1SA.23.9 were left unrepresented. Rule 32 gives an Sd only English spent on motion or place; 'thee' in 'Haste thee' is the reflexive the ASV writes for the intransitive verb's own sense and belongs to the verb under rule 44. Both endings are now unrepresented.
